Notes: Lemuria's final battle, Hall of Heroes (Advanced) (Niduus, 2026-10-28: "the final boss fight is a 8 boss fight in the SAME fight"). The game puts Stallion Quartermane and his 7 heroes all on one 12-circle battle circle (a DynamicSigil with two enemy teams of 4 and the wizards' 4) that the server cannot read or make, so the room had no battle circle at all. Here: an ordinary battle circle where the game's one stands, the 7 heroes are left out of the room, and walking into Stallion starts the fight with 3 heroes beside him; the other 4 wait and each steps into the circle of a hero who falls (Reinforcements), until all 8 have fought.

Objects.Name: HallOfHeroes_BattleCircle
Objects.Notes: Where the game's DynamicSigil stands (12.22, 733.08, 6.2, facing 3.094).

Encounters.Notes: Stallion Quartermane: 3 heroes start beside him, the other 4 step in one at a time as heroes fall.
